verdict.rationale: Phoenix is designed around SDK/CLI-driven workflows (OTLP trace ingestion, Python SDK with tracing decorators and auto-instrumentation, self-hosted server via `uvx arize-phoenix serve`, and evaluators callable programmatically without any code required for UI-based scoring), all of which support headless/CI usage. However, there is no explicit documentation of a CI pipeline example, exit-code-based test gating, or dedicated CI integration guide, so full automation-in-CI is inferred rather than directly evidenced.
